brief: Global instance accessor with a fallback default.
notes: mov eax, [0x009aaa98] / test eax, eax / jne 0x40590e
It takes no arguments and calls nothing, so the reconstruction takes the
two globals as explicit inputs rather than reproducing process addresses.
The returned value is an original 32-bit address, never a host pointer.

bookkeeping.scope: Complete fifteen-byte body; both original globals are explicit host inputs. The current native/original corpus covers 64 supplied pairs and both selection branches.
bookkeeping.supported_domain: Any two 32-bit original addresses, including zero. The original contains no branches beyond the nonzero test, so the rule is total.
unresolved: What the two globals hold and which subsystem owns the fallback.
Why five call sites in three subsystems resolve the same singleton.
bookkeeping.acceptance: Met: 64 fresh original-execution cases matched bit-exact by the native runner; self-test registered in ctest. See docs/recovery/cell-comparisons.md.
